latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-sexy-portrait-openapi-skill.
- Transforms a person photo into a bikini model image or video.
- Securely requires a WESHOP_API_KEY; prompts for key only if environment variable is unset.
- Supports custom text description, output type (video/image), and batch count (1–16).
- Includes endpoints for starting runs, polling status, and uploading images.
- Detailed usage notes and security best practices provided in documentation.
